primary_sources.role: species traits, Mb concentration and net charge data, ancestral inference

structures.notes: Sperm whale, the target taxon. 1.6 A, complete, haem plus bound O2.

known_limitations: Mirceta crystallised no ancestral myoglobins, so 1MBO can only serve as a geometric scaffold.
No measured recombinant ancestral mutation panel; the supplement gives inferred ancestral states and trait data.
Ordering claims (MB3) have no experimental ground truth at all.
expected_outcome_note: Species coverage is good here (sperm whale, elephant seal, Weddell seal all present), so MB1 and MB2 are genuinely testable. MB3 is not.

replication_targets.finding: Maximal Mb net surface charge (ZMb) increased along lineages evolving high Mb concentration; ZMb rises from about +1 to +7 in deep divers.
replication_targets.test: Do epistaeon's detected sites for MB concentrate on surface, charge-changing positions in 1MBO?

replication_targets.finding: Increased net positive charge is proposed to prevent aggregation at high Mb concentration.
replication_targets.test: Structural, not evolutionary: are the detected sites solvent-exposed rather than buried?

white_paper_claims_not_in_source.finding: The white paper asserts internal B/E-helix packing substitutions preceded surface charge accumulation.
white_paper_claims_not_in_source.test: Flag as a white paper claim without a published source. Treat as unverified unless located in Mirceta.

authority_rule: The original study is the sole authority for what counts as a replication target. Claims in white_paper_claims_not_in_source have no published source in the local materials; epistaeon must NOT be scored against them. Record what epistaeon says about them for information only, and never count a mismatch as an epistaeon failure.
